author: anon-df5e95db
content: Parses a SAM text line into a bam1_t record. 180 lines of C: splits tab-delimited fields, parses QNAME, FLAG, RNAME→tid, POS, MAPQ, CIGAR, RNEXT, PNEXT, TLEN, SEQ, QUAL, then aux tags. Complex but mechanical — all string parsing with known delimiters. Would make SAM text input FFI-free. Depends on HeaderView.tid() for RNAME→tid lookup (already Rust via cached HashMap). No other FFI dependencies for the parsing itself — the result is written into an existing bam1_t.
